as_told.title: Karl Nell on the Sed festival and the Egyptian magical papyri

plain: Karl Nell, who speaks on these subjects as a researcher, argues that the Pyramid Texts, ancient Egyptian religious writings from around 2500 BC found inside pyramids, were part of an initiation experience. He says they draw on the Sed festival, a known Egyptian kingship ritual, so that the pyramid and its texts worked as an "initiatic engine" that transformed the person going through it. The podcast host Jesse Michels later repeats the idea and adds the Egyptian magical papyri, ancient spell books, and secret brotherhoods in Egypt.
